label: Baseline
hypothesis: Freeze the original thresholded writer and recency-based retrieval.
predicted_effect: Useful direct facts work; entity and temporal ambiguity remain visible.

proposer.name: Codex
proposer.attribution: Authored by Codex while building this demo, with public access to all scenarios; no runtime provider call.

label: Agent proposal 1
hypothesis: Enabling entity filtering and time-aware retrieval will remove cross-entity distractors and exclude records outside the requested validity interval, improving complete-scenario success.
predicted_effect: Entity-grounding and distractor cases should select the requested entity, while historical and future-effective queries should return the record valid at the requested as-of date. Storage and write behavior should remain unchanged.

label: Agent proposal 2
hypothesis: Lowering the confidence threshold to 0.6 will retain the demonstrated useful low-confidence fact, while enabling deduplication will prevent repeated identical confirmations from creating extra active-history records without changing their answer.
predicted_effect: Complete-scenario success should improve on the useful-low-confidence case, and storage records should decrease for repeated identical confirmations. The existing abstentions at 0.3-0.4 should remain rejected.
